trustCharter.name: Association for AI and Data Science (ASSOCADS)

statutoryClauses.title: Educational & Skill Equity
statutoryClauses.description: Organizing, establishing and running coaching and technical training centers for competitive exams, admissions, and careers, focused on backward and minority sections.

statutoryClauses.title: Scholarships & Welfare Fund
statutoryClauses.description: Providing financial assistance, hardware, book grants, and scholarships to destitute and meritorious students to remove barriers to high-tech careers.

statutoryClauses.title: Scientific Advancements & Moral Progress
statutoryClauses.description: Promoting scientific education, technical awareness, environmental stewardship, and ethical values across all communities irrespective of caste or creed.

pillars.title: AI Talent & Skill Acceleration
pillars.description: Democratizing modern AI, Machine Learning, and Data Engineering education through university student chapters, faculty development bootcamps, and industry credentials.
capabilities: 100+ Hands-on Workshops & Faculty Development Programs (FDPs)
State-wide Campus Ambassador & Student Chapter Network
Direct Industry Mentorship for UG/PG & Research Scholars
Standardized AI/ML Competency Certifications

pillars.title: Industry-Academia Bridge & Enterprise AI
pillars.description: Bridging the curriculum-workplace gap by curating real-world project portfolios, enabling MSMEs to adopt AI solutions, and fostering high-value corporate sponsorships.
capabilities: Specialized AI Adoption Playbooks tailored for MSMEs
Corporate Co-op & Internship Matching Pipelines
Advisory desks for enterprise data governance & architecture
Collaborative B2B Innovation challenges

pillars.title: Research, Innovation & Policy Advocacy
pillars.description: Publishing evidence-based white papers and consulting with government bodies on responsible AI policies, data privacy benchmarks, and public digital infrastructure.
capabilities: Annual State AI & Data Science Outlook Report publication
Responsible AI, Algorithmic Fairness & Ethics Taskforce
State government consulting on public dataset accessibility
Collaborative research labs & international journal tie-ups

pillars.title: Startup Incubation & Venture Connect
pillars.description: Accelerating early-stage AI ventures from concept to product-market fit through specialized incubation cohorts, seed capital syndication, and angel investor showcases.
capabilities: Dedicated AI Startup Showcase & Demo Days
Angel investor roundtables & venture capital syndication
Access to cloud compute partner grants & AI credits
Product & compliance mentorship from seasoned founders

pillars.title: AI for Social Impact & Regional Upliftment
pillars.description: Harnessing emerging technologies to empower marginalized communities, improve grassroots healthcare, advance precision agriculture, and support educational scholarships.
capabilities: AI solutions for precision farming & crop yield diagnostics
Full scholarships & hardware grants for underprivileged youth
Vocational AI literacy for vernacular & rural districts
Public health diagnostics and digital welfare analytics

roadmap.title: Charter, Governance & Legal Formalities
roadmap.milestones: Establish Executive Committee, ratify trust governance charter, form inaugural Special Interest Groups (SIGs), and define statutory bylaws.

roadmap.title: Digital Portal & State Membership Drive
roadmap.milestones: Launch official ASSOCADS web portal, roll out state-wide digital membership campaign across universities, tech parks, and enterprise chambers.

roadmap.title: Bilateral Academic & Corporate MoUs
roadmap.milestones: Sign first 20 academic partnership agreements with leading state universities, institutes, and anchor technology enterprises.

roadmap.title: Community Activation & Campus Chapters
roadmap.milestones: Launch monthly physical meetups, statewide webinars, rollout Campus Ambassador programs across 50+ engineering colleges.

roadmap.title: State AI Outlook Report & Hackathon
roadmap.milestones: Publish the inaugural State Data Science Outlook Report, organize multi-track collegiate & professional hackathons with corporate prizes.

roadmap.title: Inaugural State Data Science Summit
roadmap.milestones: Convene 2,000+ delegates at the apex State Data Science Summit, confer State AI Awards, release annual impact audit and Year 2 roadmap.

events.title: Inaugural State Data Science & AI Summit 2027
events.description: The premier annual gathering of 2,000+ delegates uniting researchers, enterprises, startups, and policymakers for keynotes, hackathons, and state awards.

events.title: Masterclass: Productionizing LLMs with Agentic Architectures
events.mode: Hybrid · Tech Park Hub & Live Stream
events.description: Deep dive into autonomous multi-agent systems, context caching, tool-calling pipelines, and low-latency inference on edge nodes.

events.title: State Collegiate AI Hackathon: Generative Solutions for Public Good
events.description: Collegiate teams compete across Healthcare, Vernacular Education, Precision Agriculture, and Smart Governance. ₹3,00,000 Prize Pool.

events.title: Faculty Development Program (FDP) on Responsible & Ethical AI
events.description: 5-Day certified faculty upskilling course covering bias audits, EU AI Act compliance, explainability, and hands-on lab toolkits.
